hook: Clinging to a cooler, 30 miles out at sea.
narration: This man was clinging to a cooler, thirty miles out in the Gulf, [short pause] after Hurricane Milton.
The Coast Guard had lost contact with him at about six forty-five the night before.
An aircrew from Air Station Miami found him in open water and came in over him.
Then they lowered the hoist straight down to him.
outcome: He was pulled out alive and flown to Tampa General Hospital.
title: Clinging to a cooler 30 miles out
description:
After Hurricane Milton, a man was found clinging to a cooler about 30 miles off Longboat Key, Florida. A Coast Guard Air Station Miami aircrew rescued him on Oct. 9, 2024, and he was taken to Tampa General Hospital.

Footage: U.S. Coast Guard video, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/939855
